decisions.reason: As a compact dumper closely related to the firm's established construction equipment, it fits existing engineering, service and customer knowledge well, so the firm can learn from early market feedback and improve it through its own R&D.

The articulated construction dumper builds directly on the firm's core machinery competences and installed customer base, making commercialization and iterative refinement plausible in a growing industry.

The underground mine rescue vehicle is relatively distant from the firm's established offer, so despite its technical capabilities the firm is less likely to absorb the specialized knowledge, certification demands and user feedback efficiently enough to justify continued commitment.

A compact telescopic loader is strongly connected to the firm's existing lifting and construction know-how, allowing it to use related knowledge, service infrastructure and in-house R&D to strengthen the product.
